name: dmlab_psychlab_visual_search
title: DMLab psychlab_visual_search

obs.frame: 64x64 first-person view, 90 degree FOV, eye 0.5 cells above the floor

max_steps_source: episodeLengthSeconds 150 s x 60 fps / action repeat 4

human.controls: Click the view to look with the mouse (Esc gives it back), or use the arrow keys. The player cannot walk; you answer by where you look.
human.hint: Click the view to look around with the mouse (Esc gives it back). Look at the red cross to start a trial. Is there a pink T among the shapes? Look at the right button for yes or the left one for no, then look away to answer.

reference.name: DeepMind Lab (DMLab-30)
reference.parity: G3 (psychlab): under the dumps' gaze-controller actions the view (yaw, pitch) per frame within 1e-3 degrees, the gaze on the screen (DMLab's lookat: a muzzle-point trace) within 1e-4 of the screen, the rewards and the screen's widget changes identical; replay inputs (games/<level>.replay.json): the view accumulators' phases and each trial's objects
not_matched: pixels: the room is a cube panorama captured from the oracle at the fixed eye (tools/psych_panorama.py); the screen is drawn as solid rects
the corpus is DMLab seeds 0..31; episode seed s plays corpus entry s mod 32
actions: IMPALA's 9 plus look up and look down (IMPALA's set cannot reach the answer buttons)
trials in play: drawn with the port's PCG following the factory's rules (interleaved search modes, the staircase over set sizes), not DMLab's Lua RNG
reference.family_pins: manifest.json (oracle, action set, constants, dump hashes, files read)
